name: Raubex Group Limited
summary: Raubex Group Limited engages in the infrastructure development and construction materials business in South Africa, Australia, rest of Africa, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Materials Handling and Mining, Construction Materials, Roads and Earthworks, and Infrastructure. The Materials Handling and Mining segment is involved in the contract mining; contract crushing; materials handling and processing services for the mining industry. The Construction Materials segment produces and supplies aggregates from commercial quarries, asphalt, and value-added bituminous products.
